title: Counit-normalized localization on the actual bounded below support adjunction
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, and let i:Z→T and j:U→T be complementary closed and open immersions of schemes. Use small-etale sheaves with values in ModuleCat A [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let F=D+(i_*), R=R+(closedUpperShriek A i j), and adj=derivedPlus of the canonical supported-kernel adjunction [lem-pur-etale-supported-kernel-adjunction, lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction]. For every K in D+(T), there is a distinguished triangle F R K → K → R+j_* j* K → (F R K)[1], whose first arrow is exactly adj.counit_K and second arrow is exactly the derived ordinary open unit. Moreover, for every M in D+(Z), N in D+(U), and n in Z, Hom((F M)[n], R+j_*N) is a singleton. No Noetherian or constructibility assumption is required.

proof.text: Derive the supported-kernel adjunction with exact closed direct image on bounded below injective complexes. This is the specified adjunction and its specified counit.

The ambient closed right adjoint preserves lower bounds: Hom(B,RK)=Hom(i_*B,K)=0 when B lies below the lower bound of K. The standard t-structure supplies this criterion. Restrict its adjunction to the full D+ subcategories, and use uniqueness of right adjoints to identify it with the specified derived support adjunction, preserving the counit.

Restrict the ambient counit-normalized support triangle along the fully faithful triangulated inclusion of D+. All its terms are bounded below: inverse images and i_* are exact and R+j_* preserves a lower bound. Transport the first term by the counit-preserving adjoint identification.

Open inverse image kills every closed direct image and commutes with shifts. The derived open adjunction identifies the indicated Hom set with Hom(j*(F M)[n],N), which is a singleton since its source is zero.

theorem closedSupportPlus_localization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z T U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hij : Set.range i.base = (Set.range j.base)ᶜ) :
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)),
      ∃ δ, Triangle.mk
        ((lowerStarClosedUpperShriekAdjunction
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i j hij).derivedPlus.counit.app K)
        ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).derivedPlus.unit.app K)
        δ ∈ distTriang _) ∧
    (∀ (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
      (N : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
      (n : ℤ),
      Subsingleton
        (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M)⟦n⟧ ⟶
          (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj N))
